Q198.reason: Human genetic material is DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid); "dinitronucleic acid" is not a real term, so the team note is wrong.

Q199.reason: A pleural friction rub can be heard in both expiration and inspiration, whereas crackles are inspiratory only, so prominence in expiration points to friction rub; the team note's claim about clubbing is not a discriminating feature.

Q200.reason: Human somatic cells are diploid with 46 chromosomes (23 pairs); the team note's figure of 23 describes gametes, not somatic cells.
